certifications.name: PCI DSS Level 1
certifications.proof_quote: We invested significant time and money to obtain our Level 1 PCI certification and that our certification covers your store, its shopping cart and web hosting. All Shopify stores using our platform are automatically PCI compliant by default.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Shopify hat SOC 2 Typ II- und SOC 3-Berichte fur die Services erhalten, die es seinen Kunden bereitstellt. [Shopify has received SOC 2 Type II and SOC 3 reports for the services it provides to its customers.]

certifications.name: SOC 3
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 3 Report (April 1, 2025 to March 31, 2026) - provides assurance over the organization's system and company-level controls. Publicly accessible.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No ISO 27001 certification listed on Shopify's compliance reports page or security page. Only PCI DSS and SOC reports are published.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No HIPAA certification or BAA offering mentioned on Shopify's security or compliance pages.

privacy.ai_training_note: Shopify explicitly states: 'Shopify doesn't use any merchant's store-level data to power Shopify Magic for other merchants.' Store data is not used to train foundation models. Shopify Magic uses a merchant's own store data only to return results to that same merchant. Anonymized data may be retained for service improvement per the privacy policy.
privacy.data_region: Primary: Canada (HQ, Ottawa). EU/EEA/UK: Shopify International Ltd., Dublin, Ireland. Asia/ANZ: Shopify Commerce Singapore Pte. Ltd. Data transfers outside EWR protected by Standard Contractual Clauses and Canadian adequacy decision (EU Commission).

security.name: Bug Bounty Program
security.value: Dedicated program on HackerOne (hackerone.com/shopify and shopify.com/bugbounty). Payouts up to $200,000. Sidekick and AI features were specifically in scope for a micro-live hacking event in September 2025.

security.name: Penetration Testing
security.value: Annual on-site assessments by a Qualified Security Assessor (QSA) for PCI DSS Level 1. Quarterly external ASV vulnerability scans (most recent: April 8, 2026; prior: February 18, 2026; December 26, 2025).

security.name: Independent Audits
security.value: SOC 2 Type II audit conducted by independent external auditor. PCI DSS AoC valid June 27, 2025 to June 27, 2026, completed by a QSA annually.

security.name: Encryption
security.value: Implied by PCI DSS Level 1 compliance (requires encryption of cardholder data in transit and at rest). No specific encryption algorithm details published on the security page.

security.name: Transparency Report
security.value: Published annually. Documents legal requests for merchant/customer/partner information, evaluation process, and fulfillment rates.

security.name: Access Controls (Sidekick)
security.value: Sidekick respects store access controls: team members only interact with data and features they are authorized to use.

products.name: Shopify Sidekick
products.data_scope: Has direct access to merchant's Shopify admin data (sales, orders, inventory, traffic, products, collections). Conversations stored and used to provide personalized responses over time. Data NOT shared with other merchants or used to train foundation models.
products.notes: Embedded in the Shopify admin dashboard. Included in Shopify subscription plans. Not a separate product with its own privacy policy - governed by Shopify's overarching privacy/security framework and PCI DSS Level 1 / SOC 2 Type II coverage.

products.name: Shopify Magic
products.category: AI Feature Suite (content generation, predictions, automation)
products.data_scope: Uses merchant's own store data for AI-driven content, predictions, and automation features. Store-level data not used to power Shopify Magic for other merchants. Built on a mix of Shopify proprietary data and third-party LLMs (providers not disclosed).
products.notes: Sidekick is the conversational interface for Shopify Magic capabilities. Both are governed by the same privacy and compliance framework.

products.name: Shopify Plus
products.data_scope: Same as core Shopify plus enterprise-grade support. Likely includes more formal DPA options and dedicated compliance assistance.
products.notes: Enterprise tier merchants may negotiate custom data processing agreements. Shopify provides a dedicated privacy portal for data subject requests.

products.name: Shop / Shop Pay
products.data_scope: Consumer personal data (purchase history, payment info). Governed by separate consumer privacy policy addendum. Consumer data processed under Shopify's PCI DSS Level 1 scope.
products.notes: Different data controller/processor relationship than merchant-facing products. Consumer data requests must be made to Shopify directly (not via merchant).

products.name: Shopify POS
products.data_scope: In-person transaction data, cardholder data, customer profiles. PCI DSS Level 1 coverage extends to POS transactions processed through Shopify Payments.
products.notes: Physical card transactions add a separate compliance surface; merchants using third-party payment processors are responsible for their own PCI DSS compliance for that portion.

compare.pricing_model: Subscription (Basic, Shopify, Advanced, Plus). Sidekick included in all plans at no extra cost. Plus pricing custom/enterprise.
compare.data_residency: Primarily Canada/US. EU/EEA/UK data received by Shopify International Ltd. (Dublin, Ireland). Singapore entity for Asia/ANZ. No single-region hosting option for standard plans.

flags: DPA availability not explicitly confirmed via self-service page - Shopify Plus merchants likely have access but standard plan merchants should verify
ISO 27001 is NOT held by Shopify - some third-party Shopify partners hold it, which could cause confusion
Specific LLM providers powering Shopify Magic/Sidekick are not disclosed publicly
Sidekick 'remembers information from your conversations' - retention period for conversation history not specified in public documentation
No HIPAA BAA available - not suitable for handling protected health information in regulated healthcare contexts
